method: Hand-built: M31a governing-decision labels computed by plugins/claude-code/bench/build-m31a-key.py (regex over .mole/decisions/*.md scope: lists + git diff --name-only on the real 10-29 ledger branches, independent of @mole/decisions and of the hook code under test). Every candidate branch's TIP was independently checked with `git ls-tree -r --name-only <branch> -- .mole/decisions` to confirm the replayed checkout actually HAS the decision records (a branch cut before T29 merged has none -- 3 of the first 10 picks failed this and were dropped, logged in key-changes.md). `touch_files` lists exactly the real files that real branch's real diff (`git diff --name-only <base> <branch>`) touched among the decision-governed set; the test stages them as the session's uncommitted edit (git status, same as a real in-progress session) rather than relying on a 'last 3 commits' window, because every surviving branch's HEAD is itself a 'Merge branch main into ...' commit (git log does not diff a merge commit against a single parent by default, so the commit-window heuristic reads empty on every one of these real branches -- a genuine property of how these branches were kept in sync, not a hook bug; see key-changes.md). M31b violation/clean labels are the test author's own reading of the planted fixture file contents against the 3 planted decision rules below, independent of packages/decisions/src/rules/check.ts (checkRules), which is the code whose output we are checking.

m31a.note: 10 real sessions from this repo's 10-29 ledger task branches (git commits, not transcripts): each session checks out a real branch tip (git worktree add --detach) and stages its real touched files (touch_files, taken from that branch's real diff vs its recorded base) as an uncommitted edit, so SessionStart's existing 'files in play' logic (git status) finds them without depending on the merge-commit history quirk above. 'prompt_source' cites where the session's real first-turn instruction is committed in this repo's git history, never a transcript file. s2/s10 split the real T19 diff's file set into two subsets (cli.ts only vs notes.ts+seen.ts only) to get 2 more distinct cases out of the same real branch, after only 8 of the 10-29 branches turned out to have .mole/decisions present at their tip at all -- logged in insights.md, not fabricated data: every file in every touch_files list is a real file that real branch's real diff really changed.

decisions.title: src/core may not call the sync fs API
decisions.rule: forbid call [writeFileSync, readFileSync, appendFileSync] from src/core/

decisions.title: src/cli.ts may not import yaml
decisions.rule: forbid import [yaml] from src/cli.ts, dynamic:false (yaml picked over a fictional package so dependency-cruiser resolves it against the real node_modules already in this workspace)

decisions.title: src/core may not import back up to @app/

cases.rationale: calls fs.writeFileSync(...) inside src/core/engine.ts: a static call to a callee d1 forbids from that path
imports { readFileSync } from node:fs and calls readFileSync(...) bare (not fs.readFileSync): d1's callee list matches the bare name too
static `import { parse } from 'yaml'` in src/cli.ts: d2 forbids any static import of yaml from that exact file
`import { thing } from '@app/util'` (value import) inside src/core/: d3 forbids any import (types:true means type-only also counts) of an '@app/' module from src/core/
`import type { Util } from '@app/util'` (type-only) inside a NEW file under src/core/: d3 sets types:true so the type-only import still counts
comment-only edit, no new call or import
calls fs.readFile (the async, non-Sync variant) which is not in d1's forbidden callee list
imports 'zod', not yaml: does not match d2's module list
new pure function file under src/core/ with no imports and no fs calls
